articles.title: Li Auto Inc. January 2026 Delivery Update
articles.mainIdea: Li Auto Inc. January 2026 Delivery Update
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Li Auto Inc. January 2026 Delivery Update. BEIJING, China, Feb. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li Auto Inc. (“Li Auto” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: LI; HKEX: 2015), a leader in China’s new energy vehicle market, today announced that it delivered 27,668 vehicles in January 2026. As of January 31, 2026, Li Auto’s cumulative deliveries reached 1,567,883.
